facts.function: vacuum chamber housing and elliptical collector mirror assembly within an EUV lithography scanner

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8486 covers machines for manufacture of semiconductor devices and parts and accessories thereof
Section XVI note 2(b): parts suitable solely or principally for a particular kind of machine are classified with that machine; no exclusion in note 1 applies
GRI 6: 8486.90 parts and accessories, single 10-digit line

rejected_alternatives.reason: heading 9010 is photographic laboratory equipment; heading 8486 specifically names semiconductor manufacturing machines and their parts
the goods are parts, not the complete machine

missing_facts: whether the collector is a complete optical (mirror) assembly that could fall in chapter 90 as optical element
classification.rationale: Vacuum vessel housing and collector are dedicated parts of an EUV lithography scanner, a machine for making semiconductor devices; heading 8486 parts and accessories applies under Section XVI note 2(b). Ruling N018586 (in force) was seen but concerned laser parts classified in 9013, so it was not relied on.
